description: This file is a Perl module script for the Coocook project, specifically a script to perform a GET request and print the response body. It uses Moose for object orientation, Catalyst::Test for testing Catalyst applications, and URI for handling URIs. It defines a class with attributes for command-line arguments and a path, and includes methods for initializing with options and executing the GET request.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Get
classes.description: A Perl class representing a script to perform a GET request and output the response body, with attributes for command-line arguments and URI path, and methods for initialization and execution.

methods.name: new_with_options
methods.description: Initializes the object with command-line options, validating that exactly one URI path argument is provided.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the GET request to the specified URI and prints the response body.
